ca427a0cf2ad04.s: Which of the following is wrongly matched regarding DNA evidence?
o: Collection guideline – Documented packaging with required signatures
Anil v. State of Maharashtra (2014) – DNA reliable only with quality control
Manoj v. State of MP (2022) – Sample rejected because it came from an open area
Rahul v. State of Delhi (2022) – Documented packaging with required signatures
ca427a0cf2ad04.x: Rahul v. State of Delhi (2022) concerned a sample that remained in the Malkhana for 2 months; documented packaging with signatures is the collection guideline.

caba1ee42c0f5c.s: Which of the following is wrongly matched regarding subordinate courts?
o: Article 233 – Appointment of other judicial officers by the Governor after consulting the State PSC and High Court
Sessions Judge – Death sentence requires High Court confirmation
Chief Judicial Magistrate – Sentence up to 7 years
caba1ee42c0f5c.x: Article 233 deals with district judges, appointed by the Governor in consultation with the High Court; other judicial officers are appointed after consulting the State PSC and High Court.

ca1fa7224db913.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about refugee and migrant groups in India?
o: Tibetans number about 63,000, with a rehabilitation policy of 2014
The CAA 2019 covers six minorities who entered before 9 January 2015
Other groups, including Myanmar and Afghanistan nationals, were 2.11 lakh persons of concern as of June 2023
ca1fa7224db913.x: The CAA 2019 covers six minorities from Pakistan, Afghanistan and Bangladesh who entered before 31 December 2014; the 9 January 2015 cut-off relates to the September 2025 exemption for Sri Lankan Tamils.

ca7ab6a5208703.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Election Commission of India?
o: Under Article 324(2), it consists of the CEC and such number of ECs as the President decides
The 2023 selection committee is chaired by the Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha
A Union Cabinet Minister nominated by the Prime Minister is a member of the 2023 selection committee
The Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha is a member of the 2023 selection committee
ca7ab6a5208703.x: The 2023 selection committee is chaired by the Prime Minister; the Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha is only a member.

ca45ec4599a78d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 2025 Presidential Reference on assent to Bills?
o: The reference was made in May 2025 on Articles 200 and 201
The April 2025 case was State of Tamil Nadu vs Governor of Tamil Nadu
The cases cited were Nabam Rebia (2020) and K.M. Singh (2006)
Mandatory reservation may apply to a Bill reducing the powers of a High Court
ca45ec4599a78d.x: The years are reversed: the cited cases were Nabam Rebia (2006) and K.M. Singh (2020).

cab53508f2d86e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the creation and status of States in India?
o: Article 1 describes India as a Union of States
Jammu and Kashmir acceded in 1947 through the Instrument of Accession signed by Maharaja Hari Singh
Article 3 permits diminution of the area of a State
Goa was acquired in 1975 and Sikkim in 1961
cab53508f2d86e.x: The years are reversed: Goa was acquired in 1961 and Sikkim in 1975, and both were later made States.

caa6fe37ddf66b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Article 240?
o: Chandigarh is among the Union Territories expressly listed under Article 240
The President makes regulations for the peace, progress and good government of specified Union Territories
Such regulations have the force of an Act of Parliament
Such regulations may amend or repeal a law made by Parliament for the concerned Union Territory
caa6fe37ddf66b.x: Chandigarh is not among the Union Territories expressly listed under Article 240; the other three describe the President's regulation-making power correctly.

ca9e275e55b5c0.s: Which of the following personality-rights cases is wrongly matched?
o: Rajinikanth case – Restraint on “Main Hoon Rajnikanth”
Jackie Shroff case – Restraint on Daler Mehndi dolls
DM Entertainment v. Baby Gift House – Restraint on Daler Mehndi dolls
ca9e275e55b5c0.x: The Daler Mehndi dolls restraint was in DM Entertainment v. Baby Gift House; the Jackie Shroff case concerned protection against e-commerce and AI chatbots.

ca3acd86576919.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Section 152 BNS proceedings involving The Wire?
o: The Supreme Court issued notice on The Wire’s petition and protected journalists from coercive action
Section 152 BNS has been viewed as a rebranded Section 124A of the IPC
Section 152 BNS covers the sovereignty, unity and integrity of India
The summons included the FIR date, offence details and a copy of the FIR
ca3acd86576919.x: The summons lacked the FIR date, offence details and a copy of the FIR.

ca04ad87ffedf5.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: no dates given)
ca04ad87ffedf5.s: In which case did the Kerala High Court hold that internet access is part of Article 21 in relation to education and privacy?
o: Anuradha Bhasin vs Union of India
Shreya Singhal vs Union of India
Faheema Shirin vs State of Kerala
K.S. Puttaswamy vs Union of India
ca04ad87ffedf5.x: In Faheema Shirin vs State of Kerala, the Kerala High Court linked internet access with Article 21; Anuradha Bhasin was the Supreme Court case on indefinite shutdowns and Article 19.

cab1a592d464f2.s: Under the Supreme Court’s guidelines in Kattavellai @ Devakar v. State of Tamil Nadu, DNA samples must be sent to the Forensic Science Laboratory within:
cab1a592d464f2.x: The guidelines require transport to the FSL within 48 hours, with any delay recorded.

ca2148b6186034.s: In the Society for Unaided Private Schools of Rajasthan case (2012), the Supreme Court upheld the RTE Act but exempted:
ca2148b6186034.x: The case upheld the RTE Act as a reasonable restriction and exempted unaided minority schools.

cac1e9cc660c37.s: Who was the first Chief Information Commissioner of India (2005–2010)?
cac1e9cc660c37.x: Wajahat Habibullah was the first Chief Information Commissioner, from 2005 to 2010.

ca07eaeb6d5198.s: On which date did the Supreme Court uphold the abrogation of Articles 370 and 35A and direct restoration of statehood to Jammu and Kashmir?
ca07eaeb6d5198.x: The verdict of 11 December 2023 upheld the abrogation and directed restoration of statehood and Assembly polls.

ca69ba4299017a.s: The Jaish-e-Mohammed online course for its proposed women’s wing is scheduled to begin in:
ca69ba4299017a.x: The course, led by relatives of leaders including Masood Azhar’s sisters, starts in November 2025.

ca8cd6be536620.s: The Joint Parliamentary Committee on the Constitution (130th Amendment) Bill, 2025 consists of:
o: 21 Lok Sabha and 10 Rajya Sabha members
10 Lok Sabha and 21 Rajya Sabha members
20 Lok Sabha and 10 Rajya Sabha members
21 Lok Sabha and 11 Rajya Sabha members
ca8cd6be536620.x: The JPC has 21 Lok Sabha members and 10 Rajya Sabha members; the reverse composition is a common trap.

ca7184c4e57acd.s: In Kolhan’s Manki-Munda system, who headed 8–15 villages and acted as an appellate authority?
ca7184c4e57acd.x: The Manki headed 8–15 villages with appellate authority, while the Munda headed a single village.

ca8c2300aeeb38.s: In allowing serving judicial officers to seek direct recruitment as district judges, the Supreme Court overruled which 2020 decision?
o: All India Judges Association v. Union of India
Malik Mazhar Sultan v. U.P. Public Service Commission
Satya Narain Singh v. High Court of Allahabad
Dheeraj Mor v. High Court of Delhi
ca8c2300aeeb38.x: The judgment overruled Dheeraj Mor v. High Court of Delhi (2020), along with Satya Narain Singh (1984).

caea18d44a48a1.s: In S. Subramaniam Balaji vs State of Tamil Nadu, manifesto promises were held not to be a corrupt practice under which section of the Representation of the People Act?
caea18d44a48a1.x: The Court held that manifesto promises are not a corrupt practice under Section 123 of the Representation of the People Act.

cae6ed913bda7b.s: Foreigners Tribunals, though the Immigration and Foreigners Order, 2025 applies across India, exist only in:
cae6ed913bda7b.x: Foreigners Tribunals exist only in Assam, which has 100 tribunals.

ca8e52727269f4.s: Which section of the NDPS Act allows the Government to permit cannabis cultivation for industrial, horticultural, medical or scientific use?
ca8e52727269f4.x: Section 14 permits such cultivation, while Section 8(b) prohibits cultivation without approval.

cad6d81f686b48.s: Which section of the Draft Registration Bill, 2025 provides for end-to-end digital and offline registration?
cad6d81f686b48.x: Section 29 covers digital and offline registration and bars denial for lack of Aadhaar; Section 12 deals with compulsory registration.

ca3450fcd0eb8c.s: Who is the Patron-in-Chief of the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)?
o: Second senior-most judge of the Supreme Court
ca3450fcd0eb8c.x: The Chief Justice of India is the Patron-in-Chief; the second senior-most Supreme Court judge is the Executive Chairman.

ca552b2fc7ab65.s: In the Presidential Reference on Bills, the Centre argued that the Governor is not merely a:
ca552b2fc7ab65.x: The Centre argued that the Governor is not merely a “postman” and that judicial timelines would amount to a judicial amendment.

caa49a78907417.s: Under the All India Judges Association framework, what share of higher judicial service posts is filled by direct recruitment?
caa49a78907417.x: The framework provides 75% promotion (50% merit-cum-seniority and 25% LDCE) and 25% direct recruitment.

caf5f0a20d98ae.s: Under the May 2025 measures for Ladakh, reservation for women in the LAHDC was set at:
caf5f0a20d98ae.x: The May 2025 measures provided 33% reservation for women in the LAHDC, along with 95% job reservation for locals.

caa96232cb101e.s: A Joint Parliamentary Committee, such as the one examining the 2025 Bills on removal of Ministers, is a/an ____ body of both Houses.
caa96232cb101e.x: A Joint Parliamentary Committee is an ad hoc body and can summon officials and documents.

caca2d74ddb369.s: The Vice-President of India is elected by an electoral college consisting of:
o: Elected members of both Houses of Parliament only
Elected members of both Houses and of State Legislative Assemblies
Elected and nominated members of both Houses of Parliament
All members of the Rajya Sabha only
caca2d74ddb369.x: The electoral college consists of elected and nominated members of both Houses; State legislatures do not vote.

caa3e1e7897698.s: Which section of the Representation of the People Act, 1950 provides that only citizens can be registered as electors?
caa3e1e7897698.x: Section 16 permits registration only of citizens, in line with Article 326 on universal adult suffrage for citizens.

cae30096c761da.s: The Constitution Bench hearing the Presidential Reference on timelines for assent to Bills was led by:
cae30096c761da.x: CJI B.R. Gavai led the Constitution Bench; Justice J.B. Pardiwala was on the bench that gave the triggering 8 April 2025 judgment.

ca5d34ae81c811.s: Betting and gambling (Entries 34 and 62) fall under which list of the Seventh Schedule?
ca5d34ae81c811.x: Betting and gambling are covered under Entries 34 and 62 of the State List.

ca5a43b794bc20.s: Under MGNREGA, unemployment allowance is payable if work is not provided within:
ca5a43b794bc20.x: Unemployment allowance is payable when work is not provided within 15 days, not 30 days.

n8b0cdcac2f0.s: The 2025 Presidential Reference on the Governor’s assent concerned which Articles of the Constitution?
n8b0cdcac2f0.x: The Reference concerned the Governor’s and President’s powers under Articles 200 and 201; the five-judge Bench rejected deemed assent.

n634f5d71e46.s: Which of the following do NOT participate in the election of the Vice-President of India?
o: Nominated members of the Rajya Sabha
Elected members of the Lok Sabha
Nominated members of the Lok Sabha
n634f5d71e46.x: State Legislative Assembly members do not take part; the electoral college is formed by elected and nominated members of both Houses of Parliament.

ca95c114cf6e06.shape: statements (one-liner not possible: no verifiable same-kind decoys)
ca95c114cf6e06.s:
With reference to the proposed amendments to the Uttarakhand Uniform Civil Code Rules, 2025, consider the following statements:
1. Disclosure of pregnancy and children in live-in relationships has been deleted.
2. The Registrar may inform the parents of registrants below 21.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca95c114cf6e06.x: Disclosure of pregnancy and children (and caste details) has been deleted, but the Registrar cannot inform the parents of registrants below 21.

ca4c2ac4c58766.s: The Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025 bans:
ca4c2ac4c58766.x: The Act bans the offering, operation, promotion and playing of online money games, while promoting e-sports and social gaming through a regulatory authority.

ca5eb3a7ef3621.s: The e-Courts Project originated in the Supreme Court e-Committee’s National Policy and Action Plan for ICT in Indian Judiciary of:
ca5eb3a7ef3621.x: The project originated in the 2005 National Policy and Action Plan and is implemented by the Department of Justice with NIC under NeGP.

cacbd1b7b5fd0f.s: Under the Supreme Court’s directions, the uniform minimum age for serving judicial officers seeking direct recruitment as district judges is:
cacbd1b7b5fd0f.x: The uniform minimum age is 35 years, and seven years’ experience may combine advocacy and judicial service.

caa26f91024d04.s: According to the India Justice Report 2025, women constituted what share of High Court judges?
caa26f91024d04.x: Women formed 14% of High Court judges and 3.1% of Supreme Court judges (1 of 34).

ca1781b58e721e.s: The proposed ministerial-removal framework applies when a Minister is in custody for:
ca1781b58e721e.x: The provision concerns custody for 30 consecutive days without bail.

ca2c2845afff8e.s: The National Emergency of 25 June 1975 was declared under Article 352 on the ground of:
ca2c2845afff8e.x: It was declared on the ground of “internal disturbance” and lasted 21 months, till 21 March 1977.

ca61f9c1ed9ce2.s: India’s first medical cannabis clinic was established in 2020 in:
ca61f9c1ed9ce2.x: India’s first medical cannabis clinic was set up in Bengaluru in 2020; Uttarakhand was the first State to issue industrial-hemp licences, in 2018.

ca4f54c1a34af1.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Ordinance on Scheduled Caste sub-categorisation, the total Scheduled Caste quota is:
ca4f54c1a34af1.x: The Ordinance divides 59 Scheduled Caste communities into three groups within a total quota of 15%.

cadbc1334fc06e.s: FARC, cited as a global parallel to Left-Wing Extremism, is associated with:
cadbc1334fc06e.x: FARC is associated with Colombia; the NPA is associated with the Philippines.

cacabea56521b2.s: Which of the following was NOT among the reforms suggested for rebuilding trust in public service recruitment?
cacabea56521b2.x: The suggestions were biometric verification, encrypted paper transmission, AI analytics and a national regulator, not a national ombudsman.

ca72303ee1bd31.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh SC sub-categorisation Ordinance, Group-III, comprising 29 castes, gets a reservation of:
ca72303ee1bd31.x: Group-III (29 castes) gets 7.5%; Group-I (12 castes) gets 1% and Group-II (18 castes) gets 6.5%.

ca28ad233fc91e.s: The number of Left-Wing Extremism-affected districts, 90+ a decade ago, has now declined to:
ca28ad233fc91e.x: LWE districts have declined to 11, with the core in Bijapur, Narayanpur and Sukma in Chhattisgarh.

ca675c02a9b1f9.s: Which section of the RTI Act deals with suo motu proactive disclosure?
ca675c02a9b1f9.x: Section 4 concerns suo motu disclosure; Section 3 gives the right to information and Sections 6 and 7 cover the procedure.

cad96714b401e4.s: The first Indian Institute of Management was established in:
cad96714b401e4.x: The first IIM dates to 1961; thirteen IIMs were set up in the fifty-three years before 2014.

cad1832d19bc1b.s: Which section of the RTI Act provides for penalties?
cad1832d19bc1b.x: Section 20 provides for penalties; Sections 12–17 deal with the Information Commissions.

cabb3afbed37b5.s: Under the Code on Wages, 2019, overtime must be paid at least at:
cabb3afbed37b5.x: The Code requires overtime at least at twice the normal rate and caps deductions at 50 percent.

ca4ffed14fdc68.s: The challenge to the Online Gaming Act, 2025 on the skill-versus-chance distinction invoked which constitutional provision?
ca4ffed14fdc68.x: The challenge cited Article 19(1)(g) on the skill-versus-chance issue; Article 21 was not the cited ground.

ca2b0960df955d.s: Under the Constitution (Scheduled Castes) Order, 1950, Scheduled Caste status is available to persons professing:
ca2b0960df955d.x: The Order covers those professing Hinduism, Sikhism or Buddhism; Christianity and Islam are not included.

ca313ead9aab07.s: The Immigration and Foreigners Act, which replaced the Foreigners Act 1946, was enacted in:
ca313ead9aab07.x: It is the Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025, which also subsumed the Immigration (Carriers' Liability) Act 2000.

ca26e8ba0266d7.s: An opinion given by the Supreme Court under Article 143(1) is:
o: Binding on the State Governments only
ca26e8ba0266d7.x: An Article 143 opinion is advisory, not binding, though persuasive.

ca32284e52e00d.s: Promotees constitute about what share of the Higher Judicial Services cadre, though direct recruits dominate senior posts?
ca32284e52e00d.x: Promotees are about three-fourths of the cadre, yet direct recruits dominate senior posts, which led to the seniority hearing.

ca84cd047a5d6d.s: The Data Protection Board of India is a subordinate office of which Ministry?
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
ca84cd047a5d6d.x: The Board is a digital-by-design subordinate office of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, not an independent office.

ca3b1ad0ed82c0.s: In Mora Ho v. State of Bihar, Wilkinson’s Rules for Kolhan were held to be:
ca3b1ad0ed82c0.x: The case held that Wilkinson’s Rules were customs, not formal law.

ca4e63dad1aaef.s: Justice Sundresh observed that an absolute bar on judicial officers seeking direct recruitment as district judges violates:
ca4e63dad1aaef.x: In a concurring observation, Justice Sundresh held that such an absolute bar violates Article 14.

ca74de91da0962.s: Article 44, which concerns a Uniform Civil Code, is part of the:
ca74de91da0962.x: Article 44 is a Directive Principle of State Policy.

ca8d9ef6865687.s: Bhang, which is not a narcotic under the NDPS Act, is made from which part of the cannabis plant?
ca8d9ef6865687.x: Bhang is made from cannabis leaves and its regulation is left to the States.

cab68a0735ac5b.s: Which case formed the backdrop to the Constitution (130th Amendment) Bill, 2025?
o: Lily Thomas v. Union of India
S.R. Bommai v. Union of India
Public Interest Foundation v. Union of India
cab68a0735ac5b.x: The V. Senthil Balaji case of 2023, where a Minister continued in office despite arrest in a money-laundering case, was the backdrop.

ca538bfd92a719.s: Which Articles provide for the collective responsibility of the Council of Ministers to the legislature?
ca538bfd92a719.x: Articles 75(3) and 164(2) establish collective responsibility; Articles 75(1) and 164(1) deal with appointment.

ca53b84244cb86.s: Which Supreme Court judge flagged the misuse of criminal defamation on 22 September 2025 in the case against the Foundation for Independent Journalism?
ca53b84244cb86.x: Justice M.M. Sundresh flagged the misuse of criminal defamation on 22 September 2025.

cabeb03f17670e.s: Which Article empowers Parliament to form new States and alter their area, boundaries and names?
cabeb03f17670e.x: Article 3 covers formation of new States and alteration of area, boundaries and names; Article 2 concerns admission or establishment of new States, such as Sikkim in 1975.

ca1c243417dace.s: In which year did the Puttaswamy judgment recognise privacy as a fundamental right under Article 21?
ca1c243417dace.x: The Puttaswamy judgment of 2017 recognised privacy as a fundamental right under Article 21.

caf1768017b478.s: On the time for the Governor to act on a Bill, Article 200 states only that action should be taken:
caf1768017b478.x: Article 200 says “as soon as possible” and prescribes no specific timeline.

ca3776db13fc96.s: Which of the following is NOT correct regarding the effects of Quality Control Orders?
o: Room air conditioner output rose from about 1 million to 12 million
Hermetic compressor output rose from less than 2 million to 12 million
Birla Aircon, Meerut saw turnover rise from ₹7 crore to ₹42 crore
NITI Aayog Vice Chairman Suman Berry described QCOs as a “malign intervention”
ca3776db13fc96.x: Hermetic compressor output rose from less than 2 million to 8 million; the rise to 12 million was in room air conditioners.

ca1581323165c8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the backdrop to the RBI MPC meeting of 29 September–1 October 2025?
o: The repo rate was 5.5% with a neutral stance
GDP growth in Q1 FY26 was 7.8%
The US Federal Reserve cut its policy rate by 50 basis points
ca1581323165c8.x: The US Federal Reserve cut its rate by 25 basis points, not 50 basis points.

caae48515764f7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about solar-sector schemes and measures?
o: ALMM restricts imports through an approved list of models and manufacturers
The PLI for High Efficiency Solar PV Modules has Tranche I of ₹19,500 crore and Tranche II of ₹4,500 crore
PM Surya Ghar creates demand for solar
caae48515764f7.x: The tranches are reversed: the ₹24,000 crore PLI allocation comprises Tranche I of ₹4,500 crore and Tranche II of ₹19,500 crore.

ca3905640d3a06.shape: statements (too few confirmed facts for a NOT set)
ca3905640d3a06.s:
With reference to the approved railway projects and the PM Gati Shakti background, consider the following statements:
1. Sanchi is among the tourism destinations associated with the projects.
2. Satpura Tiger Reserve is not among the tourism destinations associated with the projects.
3. India’s logistics cost is approximately 13% of GDP.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca3905640d3a06.x: Sanchi and Satpura Tiger Reserve are both associated tourism destinations, so statement 2 is wrong; logistics cost is about 13% of GDP.

caa9907fdeffbc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the unclaimed financial assets identified by the Department of Financial Services in August 2025?
caa9907fdeffbc.x: Unclaimed mutual funds amounted to ₹3,000 crore; it was unpaid dividends that exceeded ₹9,000 crore.

ca6e52c3dbfeb8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the proposed GST rate rationalisation?
o: GST was introduced in 2017 with slabs of 5%, 12%, 18% and 28%, along with cess
The average effective GST rate is expected to rise from about 10% to about 11.5%
The 18% slab accounts for about 70% of GST revenue
ca6e52c3dbfeb8.x: The average effective GST rate is expected to fall from about 11.5% to about 10%, not rise.

ca3914aebcfe1e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the impact of the US tariff on Andhra Pradesh’s seafood exports?
o: Total duties, including tariff, anti-dumping and countervailing duties, could reach 34%
Eluru was among the districts where seafood-export activity revived
Nellore was among the districts where seafood-export activity revived
Guntur was among the districts where seafood-export activity revived
ca3914aebcfe1e.x: Guntur was not among the listed districts where activity revived; Eluru and Nellore were.

ca09a6831d3483.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the GST 2.0 restructuring?
o: GST rates were changed for 546 goods
The shift from 28% to 40% for some goods was a real increase in tax burden in every case
Over 80% of the affected goods saw rate cuts
Exempt goods do not provide Input Tax Credit
ca09a6831d3483.x: The 28% to 40% movement reflected the merger of compensation cess and was not a real hike in every case.

caa05fa4b1ecae.s: India’s CPI inflation in September 2025, a 99-month low, was:
caa05fa4b1ecae.x: September 2025 CPI inflation was 1.54%; 2.2% was the H1 FY26 average and 2.6% the RBI’s September forecast.

ca1c87ac4cba6d.s: Vizhinjam, site of an LNG bunkering facility, is how far from the East-West international shipping corridor?
ca1c87ac4cba6d.x: Vizhinjam is just 10 nautical miles from the East-West shipping corridor.

cac012aff194cf.s: India is targeting a $30 trillion economy by:
cac012aff194cf.x: The stated target is a $30 trillion economy by 2047.

caf30fbf0ee861.s: Under the proposed GST rate rationalisation, a new 40% slab was proposed for:
o: Sin goods such as tobacco, cigarettes and online real-money gaming
caf30fbf0ee861.x: The 40% slab was for sin goods such as tobacco, cigarettes and online real-money gaming.

ca8ac1d6ebd845.s: In the pre-test for India’s first National Household Income Survey, about what share of respondents were uncomfortable sharing income and tax details?
ca8ac1d6ebd845.x: About 95% of respondents were uncomfortable sharing income and tax details; India had so far relied on consumption expenditure surveys.

caf24f1e1b7b34.s: The term ‘involution’, now used for China’s EV price wars, was coined in 1969 by anthropologist:
caf24f1e1b7b34.x: Clifford Geertz coined it in 1969 for agricultural involution in Java’s wet-rice cultivation.

ca1fcddf1045cb.s: Of the 100 lakh cotton bales bought for ₹37,500 crore, how many did the Cotton Corporation of India sell?
ca1fcddf1045cb.x: CCI sold 73 lakh bales, not 83 lakh.

o: Remote access to the victim’s device
cac54b21630a39.x: Digital arrests involve impersonating police or customs officials; phishing, remote access and mule accounts are other fraud methods.

caa94f219c6f83.s: Which section of the BIS Act, 2016 enables the government to make the Standard Mark compulsory through Quality Control Orders?
caa94f219c6f83.x: Section 16 is the legal basis for compulsory use of the Standard Mark; most of the ~23,000 BIS standards are otherwise voluntary.

ca32cfb4e3956a.s: Viability Gap Funding was provided for how much battery storage across 15 States?
ca32cfb4e3956a.x: VGF covered 30 GWh of battery storage across 15 States.

cab92e95b4eddb.s: Which is the nodal ministry for PM E-DRIVE, whose September 2025 guidelines offer up to 100% subsidy for EV charging stations?
o: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
cab92e95b4eddb.x: The Ministry of Heavy Industries is the nodal ministry for PM E-DRIVE.

ca4018997b899a.s: The tender for 1.7 GW of battery storage at coal plants covers how many coal plants?
ca4018997b899a.x: The tender covers 1.7 GW of battery storage across 11 coal plants.

cabf0d104d8ad6.s: The Gondia–Dongargarh railway multi-tracking section covers which States?
cabf0d104d8ad6.x: Gondia–Dongargarh covers Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh, while Itarsi–Bhopal–Bina is in Madhya Pradesh.

ca67c73818426f.s: A draft Quality Control Order is hosted on the WTO website of which Agreement?
ca67c73818426f.x: Draft QCOs are hosted on the WTO TBT website, and six months is usually given for compliance.

ca7549751aa154.s: India’s solar installations in FY25, up 60% year-on-year, stood at:
ca7549751aa154.x: FY25 installations were 24 GW, up 60%; 11 GW was the record Q1 FY26 figure.

ca7fc3fffbdb8f.s: Equity derivatives in India, for which SEBI proposed longer tenures, currently have:
ca7fc3fffbdb8f.x: Equity derivatives currently have weekly and monthly expiry, with longer tenure proposed.

ca19b23a09abe0.s: The Production-Linked Incentive schemes, launched in 2020 with three sectors, were later expanded to:
ca19b23a09abe0.x: The PLI schemes expanded to 14 sectors; disbursals as of March 2025 covered 12 of them.

ca946638675df5.s: Which entity acquired 25% of Yes Bank for $1.6 billion?
ca946638675df5.x: SMBC acquired 25% of Yes Bank; Blackstone took 9.99% of Federal Bank and Zurich took 70% of Kotak General Insurance.

ca5630f67925eb.s: The “Your Capital, Your Right” campaign (October–December 2025) was led by:

The Free Movement Regime with Myanmar was scrapped in 2025

India has not ratified ILO Convention No. 189
Tamil Nadu’s Welfare Board under the Manual Workers Act, 1982 has a wage rate of ₹37–39 per hour

cadf67ae0cd03e.x: Karnataka’s Bill proposes a 5% employer contribution, not an employee contribution.

Articles 330 and 332 – Reservation of seats in the Lok Sabha and Assemblies
caae5b8d4238d7.x: Article 366(25) defines Scheduled Tribes; reservation of seats is provided by Articles 330 and 332.

ca293351c2b57c.s: ISRO’s IADT-1 validated which system of the Gaganyaan crew module?
ca293351c2b57c.x: IADT-1 validated the parachute-based deceleration system; it was not an orbital flight.

ca99e94dff398a.s: In LLM training, which stage uses human labels?
ca99e94dff398a.x: Supervised learning uses human labels; reinforcement learning uses human feedback.

ca8314ed99ac18.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Himalayan glacial lakes and GLOFs?
o: The CWC monitored 2,843 lakes, of which 1,435 increased in size
South Lhonak in Sikkim (2023) is a cited GLOF event
Dig Tsho in Nepal (1985) is a cited GLOF event
IPCC AR6 projects that about one-third of Himalayan glaciers may vanish by 2100 under high emissions
ca8314ed99ac18.x: IPCC AR6 projects about two-thirds, not one-third, of Himalayan glaciers may vanish by 2100 under high emissions.

ca1a5ddaaf7696.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Vikalpa report on coal operations?
o: Coal and lignite accounted for 50% of electricity in 2022–23
Coal dust PM10 reached up to five times the limit, or 460 μg/m³
The report linked health impacts with silica, cadmium and lead
NGT compensation was often delayed or partial
ca1a5ddaaf7696.x: Coal and lignite accounted for 73% of electricity in 2022–23; about 50% is the 2031–32 figure.

ca676636623ff1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan?
o: It is named after Birsa Munda
It provides ₹15,000 per hectare to Gram Sabhas for CFRMPs
It targets 1,000 CFRMPs in two years
ca676636623ff1.x: The Abhiyan was launched in October 2024; FRA cells are functional in Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh and Odisha.

ca9260db637db1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about global responses to plastic pollution?
o: A health letter was signed by 18 million health professionals across 88 countries
UNEP aims to cut plastic waste by 80% within one decade
At UNEA-5, all 193 members agreed to negotiate a legally binding plastics treaty
EPR stands for Extended Producer Responsibility
ca9260db637db1.x: The UNEP aim is to cut plastic waste by 80% in two decades, not one.

caa24ed7f04d45.shape: statements (too few confirmed facts for a NOT set)
caa24ed7f04d45.s:
With reference to India’s 2030 Nationally Determined Contribution, consider the following statements:
1. Emissions intensity of GDP is to be cut by 45% from 2005 levels.
2. The non-fossil installed-capacity target is 45%.
3. The additional carbon-sink target is 2.5–3 billion tonnes of CO2e.
Which of the above statements are correct?
caa24ed7f04d45.x: The emissions-intensity target (45% from 2005) and the 2.5–3 billion tonne carbon sink are correct; the non-fossil capacity target is 50%.

ca33f1541cd751.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about OCI’s “Planet Wreckers” report?
o: The USA accounted for over 90% of the net global increase in oil and gas output
The six major companies recorded profits of more than $580 billion
ca33f1541cd751.x: Fossil-fuel subsidies were $465 billion; $280 billion was the climate finance paid since 2015.

caafe8fc0a65df.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about e-waste and public health in India?
o: Sixty-five cities produce more than 60% of India’s e-waste
India has 232 registered formal e-waste recyclers
Only 43% of e-waste was processed formally in 2023–24
PM2.5 in Seelampur exceeded 300 μg/m³, 12 times the WHO 24-hour limit
caafe8fc0a65df.x: India has 322 registered formal recyclers, not 232.

ca66dd1a80759d.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: no dates given)
ca66dd1a80759d.s: A well blowout is an uncontrolled release of oil or gas when well pressure overcomes the blowout preventers and the:
ca66dd1a80759d.x: A blowout occurs when well pressure beats the blowout preventers and drilling mud; faulty valves and wrong mud weight are causes.

ca3385d7ce54cb.shape: statements (one-liner not possible: no verifiable same-kind decoys)
ca3385d7ce54cb.s:
With reference to India’s surface solar-radiation outlook, consider the following statements:
1. The Indo-Gangetic Plains and the North-East may see a marginal increase in surface solar radiation under low emissions.
2. North-west India is projected to be the most unstable region in terms of surface solar radiation.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca3385d7ce54cb.x: The Indo-Gangetic Plains and the North-East may see a marginal increase under low emissions; statement 2 reverses the finding about north-west India.

caf70b6810dc7e.s: India will need 144 million new homes by:
caf70b6810dc7e.x: The 144 million new homes requirement is by 2070; cities are expected to generate over 70% of new jobs in the next 5 years.

cab93885210207.s: World Dugong Day is observed on:
cab93885210207.x: World Dugong Day is on 28 May; India’s largest dugong population is in the Gulf of Mannar–Palk Bay region.

cac0d9d7a027ce.s: Of the 353 million tonnes of global plastic waste, what share was recycled?
cac0d9d7a027ce.x: Only 9% was recycled, while 19% was incinerated; packaging accounted for 40% of plastic waste.

caf69213a5e7f5.s: The highest peak of the Western Ghats (2,695 m) is:
caf69213a5e7f5.x: Anamudi in Kerala, at 2,695 m, is the highest peak of the Western Ghats (Sahyadri).

ca9ee3f6568cb5.s: The gecko Dravidogecko coonoor, endemic to Coonoor in the Nilgiris, was earlier thought to be:
ca9ee3f6568cb5.x: The species was earlier identified as Hemidactylus anamallensis.

ca405846da9965.s: Under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, the dugong is listed in:
ca405846da9965.x: The dugong is a Schedule I species and is not found along the entire Indian coast.

ca95f7ffd9b6c1.s: After the 2015 Paris Agreement’s shift to voluntary NDCs, which climate-finance promise remained unmet?
ca95f7ffd9b6c1.x: The promise of $100 billion a year in climate finance remained unmet.

ca2026ebdb4bc7.s: Wildlife biologist Rakesh Kalva, associated with Andhra Pradesh’s Elephant Task Force, is linked with which NGO?
ca2026ebdb4bc7.x: Rakesh Kalva is associated with the NGO FREE WILD; the task force provides 24x7 monitoring and real-time alerts.

ca49cd23e7aa15.s: The Van Rakshak Project was started in 2000 by the Wildlife Trust of India with:
ca49cd23e7aa15.x: WTI started the project with IFAW in 2000; it has supported more than 21,000 personnel.

caf4a4994e2827.s: According to the WMO Greenhouse Gas Bulletin, the atmospheric CO₂ level in 2024 was:
caf4a4994e2827.x: CO₂ was 423.9 ppm in 2024; methane accounted for about 16% of the warming effect.

cad2bc53ee43cd.s: Nepal’s grant under the Kunming Biodiversity Fund focuses on:
cad2bc53ee43cd.x: Nepal’s grant focuses on invasive species management; the Cook Islands grant is on community empowerment.

ca4e12d70e7def.s: Phase I of the artificial reef project off Jalari Yendada comprises how many reef units?
ca4e12d70e7def.x: Phase I has 22 reef units within 2.5 km of the shore, funded 60:40 by the Centre and State under PMMSY.

ca9c90c1ff944f.s: Kaziranga National Park holds about what share of the world’s one-horned rhinoceroses?
ca9c90c1ff944f.x: Kaziranga has about two-thirds of the world’s one-horned rhinos, more than 2,500.

caf499c12401f5.s: The Forest Survey of India tracks large forest fires using SNPP and:
caf499c12401f5.x: FSI tracks large fires using both SNPP and MODIS.

cad434c694fc10.s: According to the CWC’s June 2025 report, which State/UT recorded the highest number of expanding glacial lakes (197)?
cad434c694fc10.x: Arunachal Pradesh had the most expanding lakes, 197; Ladakh had 120.

ca539d8a445c26.s: The Mithakari Group sandstone and shale of the Baratang mud volcano belong to which epoch?
ca539d8a445c26.x: The rocks are Oligocene (33.9–23 million years ago); activity is linked to Indian Plate subduction beneath the Burma Microplate and shale diapirism.

caa694c732bae1.s: During the 2025 monsoon, Northwest India recorded excess rainfall of:
caa694c732bae1.x: Northwest India recorded 27% excess; Central India 15% and the South Peninsula 10%.

cae116d79788c6.s: Of the 51.23 lakh claims received under the Forest Rights Act, how many were rejected?
cae116d79788c6.x: 18.62 lakh claims were rejected; 7.49 lakh were pending and titles were given for 25.11 lakh.

ca1ec072c12ed7.s: According to NITI Aayog, about how many Indians face high to extreme water stress?
ca1ec072c12ed7.x: About 600 million Indians face high to extreme water stress.

caf0a4ba131358.s: The August 2025 Asian giant tortoise conservation effort in Manipur, the first artificial hatching of the species in mainland Asia, produced how many hatchlings?
caf0a4ba131358.x: The effort produced 28 hatchlings; 25 staff were trained on 21 August 2025.

ca067c2f8565c9.x: Project Elephant dates to 1992; India has more than 60% of the world’s Asian elephants.

ca8a314b8fed8d.s: The Northeast monsoon contributes about what share of Tamil Nadu’s annual rainfall?
ca8a314b8fed8d.x: The Northeast monsoon contributes 48% of Tamil Nadu’s annual rainfall and over 30% of Andhra Pradesh’s.

ca1dcb9322df7a.s: The IUCN status of the dugong, India’s only herbivorous marine mammal, is:
ca1dcb9322df7a.x: The dugong is Vulnerable on the IUCN list and is in CITES Appendix I.

cad3783d8d010b.s: How many Dravidogecko species are known from the Western Ghats?
cad3783d8d010b.x: The Western Ghats have nine Dravidogecko species; D. coonoor was found entirely outside protected areas.

ca9c401e5753ce.s: The Central Water Commission found how many of India’s 681 glacial lakes to be expanding?
ca9c401e5753ce.x: The CWC recorded expansion in 432 of 681 glacial lakes.

ca1832460cdb71.s: Under the Cali Fund, what share of contributions from digital sequence information users goes to Indigenous Peoples?
ca1832460cdb71.x: The Cali Fund allocates 50% to Indigenous Peoples; KMGBF Target 19 envisages $200 billion a year by 2030.

ca0ea3c8da3b8c.s: The principal impact associated with a ‘thirstwave’ is:
ca0ea3c8da3b8c.x: Thirstwaves are associated mainly with crop water stress.

ca9ead007bd543.s: The Dudhia bridge, washed away in October 2025 and cutting the Siliguri–Mirik link, was over which river?
ca9ead007bd543.x: Heavy rain washed away the Dudhia bridge over the Balason River.

ca90448b285825.s: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana, linked with the Blue Economy and SDG-14, was launched in:

caf6b251707616.s: The theme of World Environment Day 2025 was:
caf6b251707616.x: The 2025 theme was “Ending Plastic Pollution”, not “Eliminating Plastic Pollution”.

ca638bee21bc32.s: India’s National Designated Authority for carbon markets, notified on 22 August 2025, is mandated under which Article of the Paris Agreement?
ca638bee21bc32.x: The authority is mandated under Article 6, not Article 5; MoEFCC notified it on 22 August 2025.

ca84cc7e63dff5.s: Under the IMD definition, a cloudburst involves at least how much rainfall in one hour over about 20–30 sq km?
ca84cc7e63dff5.x: IMD defines a cloudburst as at least 100 mm of rain in one hour over about 20–30 sq km.

cad65412772bab.s: In its counter affidavit defending the Forest Rights Act, 2006, the Ministry of Tribal Affairs stated that the Act has no:
cad65412772bab.x: The Ministry defended the Act and its 2012 Rules and stated that the Act has no sunset clause.

cae87027978326.s: Before its latest inter-state transfer of elephants, the previous recipient of Karnataka’s elephants was:
cae87027978326.x: Maharashtra was the previous recipient; this was Karnataka’s first inter-state transfer after a two-year gap.

cad0ced12c5ae7.s: The artificial reef project off Jalari Yendada was launched on 20 May 2025 by Fisheries Minister:
cad0ced12c5ae7.x: Fisheries Minister Kinjarapu Atchannaidu launched it; funding is 60% Centre and 40% State under PMMSY.

caa4de8113f84c.s: The rise in saltwater crocodile numbers in the Sundarbans was credited to the:
caa4de8113f84c.x: The Bhagabatpur Crocodile Project’s captive breeding and release was credited with the increase.

ca4fd95303a83c.s: The saltwater crocodile, an apex predator and hypercarnivore, serves as an indicator of the health of:
ca4fd95303a83c.x: The saltwater crocodile indicates mangrove health, and it tolerates wide variations in salinity.

ca7a5e4303d455.s: India’s Dugong Conservation Reserve, established in Palk Bay in 2022, covers:
ca7a5e4303d455.x: The reserve is in Palk Bay and covers 448 sq km.

ca09401739cd96.s: Thirstwaves are measured using standardised short-crop evapotranspiration (ET₀) based on a theoretical grass crop of height:
ca09401739cd96.x: ET₀ is based on a theoretical 12 cm grass crop; thirstwaves reflect temperature, low humidity, wind and solar radiation.

caf09bcfb050e5.s: In the ISRO Landslide Atlas 2023, Darjeeling ranks ____ among the 147 most landslide-exposed districts.

cacde24077899f.s: A vast offshore freshwater aquifer has been found beneath the Atlantic Ocean between New Jersey and:
cacde24077899f.x: The aquifer lies from New Jersey to Maine and is not directly recharged by current rainfall.

ca9a58851d017e.s: The rise in atmospheric CO₂ from 2023 to 2024, the largest since measurements began in 1957, was:
ca9a58851d017e.x: CO₂ rose by 3.5 ppm from 2023 to 2024, the largest rise since 1957.
